q: Objection to the sub's April Fools content carried by three or more concepts
w: The moderators' Spanish and German theme leads, played inside with Dutch-revolt role play ('1 opwillem = 1 spanjool minder'); one plain objection ('1 april is kut') and a request for the old picture back fall short of three, and whether in-character protest inside the takeover counts as objection the test does not say.
The upvote, downvote, banner and New Link button are reskinned for April, the sub's own look changed; my B1 placement as a canvas sub was wrong.
The TSM banner and restyle of the sub lead; four concepts work out whether the banner and the Forsen news are April Fools, which T3-023's rule adds at three or more.
The moderators require every comment to be 'Data.' for the day and members comply; a rule change to the sub played inside, not a member's fake as my B1 had it.
The sub's swapped look (Warframe's theme, the left sidebar, Club Penguin) leads; members report the sidebar breaking text and upvotes and ask for the icon back, T3-097.

A place photograph is posted and admired with a joke about the tourism ministry; nothing in the words plays the moderators' no-English joke, so this is the sub's ordinary talk. Both readers placed it from the note's framing.

The moderators' CSS and identity swap with r/Tales leads, played inside; restoring flairs and coping with exposed spoilers after the swap (T3-097) and working out which sub this is (T3-095) each have three or more concepts of their own.

q: A change made to a whole sub for April Fools
w: A rival-themed sub advertises its own new look in r/FlashTV and recruits; T3-023's test speaks of 'a whole sub' without saying whose, so another sub's restyle advertised in this room is placed by neither it nor T3-064 cleanly.
The Kimi and Quokka day the moderators made of the sub leads; members' fake news posted as true (Hamilton retiring, the Ecclestone-Dennis team, the Bernie AMA) has concepts of its own.
Members play inside the moderators' real-animal turn; four concepts settle that it is April Fools ('read the sticky its april first'), which T3-023's rule adds at three or more.
The moderators' tilted page leads; four concepts report it hinders reading and escape it on mobile, and three ask whether it is April Fools, each added by T3-023's rule.
The moderators' mock GameSpot merger leads, played and repaired inside; three concepts call the day's jokes the worst, tiresome and a sell-out, T3-032's floor.

Both readers place the moderators' Overwatch makeover and flag the item a bag: members work out the change, switch it off, object to it and ask to keep it, each in concepts of their own beyond three placements; my B1 T3-095 took only the working out.
The drachma banner and flair the sub wore for the day lead, played inside; two members post fakes as true (Tsipras abolishing the memoranda, a poll hoax), concepts of their own.
Only the title 'Place' survives, its body removed; it shows no doing, which is why I left it unplaced at B1, and both readers placed it from the note's timing.
Members accuse and deny causing the sub's reversed style, joking inside the day's change; not an in-joke played in canvas talk as my B1 had it.

A provocation is written in the sub's reversed form for the day; reversed, it calls h3h3 'jewish haters alt-right neo-nazis'. The doing placed is writing inside the day's reversed style; my B1 in-joke reading fails the canvas condition.
The moderators' banner prank and fake community manager lead; three concepts call the prank mean and cruel, T3-032's floor.
Members play inside the moderators' Breadman makeover, and three concepts ask to keep it forever, until the Cup, or bring it back; my B1 grouping left the keeping out.
The moderators' memes-only day is announced, enforced and played inside; the complaints (a real help issue, keep the sub shitpost-free) are two, short of T3-032's floor of three.
The Jack Kirby takeover of the sub leads; three concepts say the room is doomed, demand the games back and call for the pink puff, objecting to the joke.
The moderators recast the sub as pro-Laine through the sidebar, automod and buttons; five concepts object and ask for the posts and pictures down; my B1 grouping left the objecting out.

The coder's theme holds the moderators' Merrill takeover, members' objections, automatic removals of canvas posts under the standing rules and an argument that the mods broke their own rules for the day, more than three placements carry (conflict CC-004).
The moderators turn the sub blue; members object that it should come off by noon and not on derby day, and a moderator points to the style-off switch; my B1 grouping held only the takeover.

q: A change made to a whole sub for April Fools
w: One title reports that r/BattleNetwork bans spinoffs for the day; the changed sub is another one, and T3-023's 'whole sub' does not say whose, as at flashtv t14.
